# VolumeControl

[Framework](README.md) · `DotGame.Framework.Audio` · class

```csharp
public sealed class VolumeControl : IDisposable
```

A volume that voices and music play through, which can be set, faded and chained under other controls. Sharing one between sounds makes a group.

## Properties

### Volume

```csharp
public float Volume { get; set; }
```

Gets or sets the volume level, from 0 (silent) to 1 (maximum volume). A value outside that is clamped to it on every platform, as one worked out with floats can land just past it.

**Throws `ObjectDisposedException`:** The control has been disposed.

**Throws `ArgumentOutOfRangeException`:** The value is not a number.

## Methods

### Dispose

```csharp
public void Dispose()
```

Releases the control. Whatever is still under it goes silent, as a game that disposes a control before the sounds and controls it made under it has a bug that shouldn't get louder. The master control belongs to the audio service, and this does nothing to it.

### FadeTo

```csharp
public void FadeTo(float toVolume, TimeSpan duration, FadeCurve? curve = null)
```

Types: [`FadeCurve`](FadeCurve.md)

Gradually changes the volume to a specified value over a duration.

| Parameter | |
|---|---|
| `toVolume` | The target volume level, from 0 (silent) to 1 (full volume). A value outside that is clamped to it. |
| `duration` | The total time over which the fade occurs. Must be a positive value. |
| `curve` | The shape the fade follows, or `null` to use [`FadeCurve.Exponential`](FadeCurve.md#exponential). |

**Throws `ObjectDisposedException`:** The control has been disposed.

**Throws `ArgumentOutOfRangeException`:** The volume is not a number.

The default fade is exponential (a constant number of decibels per second), so it is perceived as changing at a steady rate rather than dropping away abruptly at the end of a fade-out. [`FadeCurve`](FadeCurve.md) offers other built-in shapes, and custom shapes are supported by deriving from it. The same curve is applied whether the volume is rising or falling.
